description: This header defines the API for USB Audio Class 2 device interaction, including callback structures, registration functions, and data transmission functions, specific to the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: usbd_uac2_set_ops
methods.description: Registers application callbacks for USB Audio Class 2 device events.

methods.name: usbd_uac2_send
methods.description: Sends audio data to the specified output terminal.
